★★★★☆

Used Kilbarrack Van Co for a move from Phibsborough to Drumcondra in October. Overall, I’d use them again. Good value, plenty of hard work and a few things they did that made the day much easier, but there were two issues worth mentioning.

It was a two-bed flat, mostly my stuff, and the new place is on the fourth floor with no lift. The quote was €340 for two lads and the van for up to four hours. They got it done in about three and a half, which I thought was good going considering the stairs. Other quotes I’d had were €450 upwards, so they were the best value I found. Booking was through the website, with a €50 deposit paid by Revolut.

The main snag at the start was the timing. They were booked for 9am and arrived at 10.30. Dessie did text at 8.40 to say the previous job had overrun, so I wasn’t left wondering whether they were coming, but it was still an hour and a half sitting around on boxes with a cold coffee. It wasn’t a disaster for me, but if you’ve a tight handover with a landlord, that sort of delay could be a problem. Dessie knocked €40 off afterwards without me asking, which I appreciated.

Once they got there, they got stuck in. The couch wouldn’t go round the turn on the third floor and I was wondering how that was going to work. One of the lads had an Allen key in his pocket, took the legs off and got it straight in. They also put the bed back together without being asked and took away a flat-pack shelf I didn’t want. Those were genuinely helpful things to have sorted on moving day, especially after carrying everything up four floors.

The disappointing bit was a chip to the base of my brass floor lamp. They used blankets on the other things, but the lamp wasn’t wrapped and it got damaged. It was my nanny’s, so I was fairly gutted about that. It matters to me to mention it here rather than give the impression everything arrived without a mark. A bit more care with wrapping that piece would have made a difference.

So, four stars feels fair. They worked hard, dealt with awkward furniture and a lot of stairs, and the price was very reasonable. The discount for the delay was a decent gesture too. I’d book them again, but I’d leave some breathing room on the timing and make sure anything fragile or sentimental was properly wrapped before it went into the van. Wrap the lamps, lads!
